# Answers
> Community-driven question-and-answer platform with study resources, topic hubs, and reference content across academic and everyday subjects.

Answers.com organizes user-contributed and editorial knowledge into subject pages, study guides, and question threads spanning science, history, language arts, mathematics, social studies, health, business, and practical life topics.

## Core Site
- [Answers Homepage](https://www.answers.com): Main entry point for browsing questions, topics, and study resources.
- [Notifications](https://www.answers.com/notifications): User notifications area for account activity and site updates.
- [Topics](https://www.answers.com/topics): Directory for exploring subject areas and knowledge categories.
- [Categories](https://www.answers.com/categories): Category index for navigating broad content groupings.
- [Trending](https://www.answers.com/trending): Popular and currently active questions across the platform.

## Science
- [Biology](https://www.answers.com/biology): Biology questions and study material covering cells, genetics, ecology, and anatomy.
- [Chemistry](https://www.answers.com/chemistry): Chemistry explanations and Q&A on elements, compounds, reactions, and matter.
- [Physics](https://www.answers.com/physics): Physics resources covering motion, forces, energy, waves, and electricity.
- [Earth Science](https://www.answers.com/earth-science): Earth science content on geology, weather, oceans, and planetary systems.
- [Astronomy](https://www.answers.com/astronomy): Astronomy questions about stars, planets, space, and celestial phenomena.
- [Zoology](https://www.answers.com/zoology): Zoology study content focused on animals, classification, and behavior.
- [Botany](https://www.answers.com/botany): Botany questions and explanations about plants, growth, and classification.

## Mathematics
- [Mathematics](https://www.answers.com/math-and-arithmetic): General math and arithmetic questions, formulas, and worked explanations.
- [Algebra](https://www.answers.com/algebra): Algebra help covering equations, variables, expressions, and functions.
- [Geometry](https://www.answers.com/geometry): Geometry resources on shapes, angles, proofs, and measurement.
- [Calculus](https://www.answers.com/calculus): Calculus questions involving limits, derivatives, and integrals.
- [Statistics](https://www.answers.com/statistics): Statistics explanations for probability, distributions, and data analysis.
- [Trigonometry](https://www.answers.com/trigonometry): Trigonometry content on angles, identities, and triangle relationships.

## History & Social Studies
- [US History](https://www.answers.com/us-history): US history questions on periods, events, leaders, and institutions.
- [World History](https://www.answers.com/world-history): World history coverage spanning civilizations, empires, and global conflicts.
- [Geography](https://www.answers.com/geography): Geography questions about places, regions, maps, and physical features.
- [American Government](https://www.answers.com/american-government): Civics and government content on branches, laws, and public institutions.
- [Sociology](https://www.answers.com/sociology): Sociology resources covering society, culture, groups, and social behavior.
- [Anthropology](https://www.answers.com/anthropology): Anthropology questions on human origins, cultures, and societies.
- [Economics](https://www.answers.com/economics): Economics explanations about markets, trade, production, and policy.

## Language Arts & Humanities
- [English Language Arts](https://www.answers.com/english-language-arts): Language arts help with grammar, reading, writing, and literature.
- [Literature and Language](https://www.answers.com/literature-and-language): Questions on authors, texts, vocabulary, and literary concepts.
- [Poetry](https://www.answers.com/poetry): Poetry-related questions on forms, devices, and interpretation.
- [Linguistics](https://www.answers.com/linguistics): Linguistics content on language structure, meaning, and usage.
- [Philosophy](https://www.answers.com/philosophy): Philosophy questions about thinkers, ethics, logic, and ideas.
- [Mythology](https://www.answers.com/mythology): Mythology topics covering legends, deities, and traditional stories.
- [Arts and Crafts](https://www.answers.com/arts-and-crafts): Creative arts questions and practical craft-related information.

## Health & Life Sciences
- [Health](https://www.answers.com/health): General health questions and reference content on wellness and conditions.
- [Anatomy and Physiology](https://www.answers.com/anatomy-and-physiology): Human body systems, structures, and biological function explanations.
- [Nutrition](https://www.answers.com/nutrition): Nutrition questions on diet, nutrients, food groups, and healthy eating.
- [Conditions and Diseases](https://www.answers.com/conditions-and-diseases): Reference answers about illnesses, symptoms, and medical terminology.
- [Medication and Drugs](https://www.answers.com/medication-and-drugs): Information on medicines, drug categories, and common uses.
- [Psychology](https://www.answers.com/psychology): Psychology questions on behavior, cognition, development, and mental processes.

## Business, Law & Technology
- [Business and Finance](https://www.answers.com/business-and-finance): Business and finance questions on companies, money, and management.
- [Personal Finance](https://www.answers.com/personal-finance): Personal finance help covering budgeting, credit, and saving.
- [Law and Legal Issues](https://www.answers.com/law-and-legal-issues): Legal reference questions on rights, procedures, and terminology.
- [Computer Science](https://www.answers.com/computer-science): Computer science topics including programming, systems, and theory.
- [Technology](https://www.answers.com/technology): Technology questions on devices, software, and digital tools.
- [Internet](https://www.answers.com/internet): Internet-related content on web usage, services, and online concepts.

## Everyday Life
- [Food and Cooking](https://www.answers.com/food-and-cooking): Cooking questions, ingredient information, and kitchen techniques.
- [Home and Garden](https://www.answers.com/home-and-garden): Practical answers for home care, gardening, and household projects.
- [Jobs](https://www.answers.com/jobs): Career and employment questions about roles, workplaces, and hiring.
- [Travel and Places](https://www.answers.com/travel-and-places): Travel-related questions on destinations, transportation, and planning.
- [Sports](https://www.answers.com/sports): Sports questions on rules, teams, records, and athletic topics.
- [Cars and Vehicles](https://www.answers.com/cars-and-vehicles): Vehicle-related questions on models, maintenance, and transportation.
- [Animals](https://www.answers.com/animals): Everyday animal questions on pets, wildlife, and behavior.

## Education & Study Support
- [Study Guides](https://www.answers.com/study-guides): Central hub for subject-based study materials and learning support.
- [Homework Help](https://www.answers.com/homework-help): Academic question pages intended to support student assignments.
- [College Applications and Entrance Requirements](https://www.answers.com/college-applications-and-entrance-requirements): Admissions-related questions on colleges, requirements, and applications.
- [Example Essays](https://www.answers.com/example-essays): Sample essay content and writing references for students.
- [Research Papers](https://www.answers.com/research-papers): Research paper guidance and topic-related academic reference material.

## Reference & Culture
- [History of the United States](https://www.answers.com/history-of-the-united-states): Additional US historical reference content and question archives.
- [Religion and Spirituality](https://www.answers.com/religion-and-spirituality): Questions on beliefs, traditions, and religious concepts.
- [Celebrities](https://www.answers.com/celebrities): Celebrity-related factual questions and biographical information.
- [Movies and Television](https://www.answers.com/movies-and-television): Entertainment questions on films, shows, and performers.
- [Books and Literature](https://www.answers.com/books-and-literature): Book-related questions, summaries, and literary reference content.
- [Music](https://www.answers.com/music): Music questions on artists, theory, genres, and songs.
